finding: The filter has no exemption for action rows, so the assistant 'No assistant' clear row is filtered away by any query — a user who types to find an assistant can no longer clear the current one. Regression introduced BY adding search.
Same finding, reported independently: pinned/action rows must survive the filter.

Rows are non-focusable divs with no mousedown preventDefault; the Base UI popup is tabIndex=-1, so the first click moves focus off the search input. For the multi-select KB picker (stays open by design) every later keystroke is dead and aria-activedescendant points from an unfocused element. The e2e masked it because Playwright fill() re-focuses.
Same finding, reported independently and reproduced by a mounted probe (document.activeElement moved off the input after a row click).

The no-matches state emits aria-expanded=true plus a dangling aria-controls (the listbox is not rendered) — axe aria-valid-attr-value, critical impact, reachable from the gallery surface this branch adds, with no baseline entry.
Same finding at lower severity: the ARIA contract is self-inconsistent in the no-matches state.
TEST-13's control assertion was unsatisfiable (min-width-clamped control 240px vs max-width-clamped subject 320px). Oracle-confirmed: the test actually went RED in the first e2e run.

Scroll-reachability was vacuous: Playwright toBeVisible() is true for a row clipped inside an overflow scroller, so deleting the scroll step left the test green. Replaced with bounding-box containment before/after.
TEST-16's parity comparison is true by construction (both sides render the same component), so it stayed green if BOTH caps were deleted. Now also asserts absolute cap values.

TEST-18 never measured icon size (claimed) and hid its cross-item comparison behind an if(isVisible()). Icon size now measured; comparison made unconditional against the always-present file-attach item.

TEST-20 claimed gate:ui coverage for gallery STORIES at 390px. runtime-health enumerates pages/overlays/deep/seeded only (stories are not a surface class) and is hardcoded to 1280x900. Filtered + no-matches are now OverlayEntries; the prose states exactly which layer covers what.
`disabled` on ComposerPickerItem is dead — no production, gallery or test caller — making its guard, aria-disabled attribute and two utility classes unreachable (CODING_GUIDELINES 15). Removed.

TEST-9's kit-import assertions passed VACUOUSLY for AssistantMenuItem (it has no @ziee/kit import at all, so the checked list was empty). Added a positive control plus an assertion that the primitive DOES own those imports.

aria-haspopup="listbox" on the trigger overrides Base UI's correct aria-haspopup="dialog" (render-element props win the merge), so AT announces a listbox while focus lands in a dialog. Removed from both callers.
cloneElement(trigger, {aria-expanded}) is redundant (Base UI's Trigger already emits it) and is the exact mechanism by which a caller prop can override the correct value. Removed.

The listbox lacked aria-multiselectable although the KB picker is multi-select; the old rows expressed the toggle with aria-pressed and nothing replaced it. Added a multiSelect prop wired by KbMenuItem.
'No matches.' was a hardcoded English literal in a component whose stated contract is that the caller owns i18n. Promoted to a required noMatchesText prop.

No <640px coverage anywhere, for a 240px-min panel opening side=right from a nested popover. Added TEST-22 at 390x844 asserting horizontal containment, the height cap and no document horizontal scroll.

With a selection but zero available assistants, the pinned clear row made items non-empty so emptyContent never rendered; the old file showed both. The empty state now keys on non-pinned CHOICES and still renders pinned action rows.
Enter preventDefault fired even with no active row; Home/End guarded preventDefault while the arrows did not; `active < 0 ||` was a dead branch. All three normalized.
No IME-composition guard on Escape/Enter, unlike the Base UI dismiss it replaces (whose guard can never run because this handler stopPropagations). Added an isComposing early return.
Docblock still described the pre-change world ('the Assistant item reuses the same wrapper classes'). Updated — every '+' item now renders the component.
The panel read 'No assistants available' while the trigger above it read 'Loading assistants…' in the same frame. The empty text is now loading-aware.

Predicted: Enter on the trigger double-toggles (PlusMenuItem's own onClick plus Base UI's useButton emulation), so the picker never opens. NOT REPRODUCIBLE — a mounted probe driving the REAL PlusMenuItem trigger shows the picker opens; now locked by TEST-25 (unit) and a real-browser keyboard-open leg in TEST-15.

A per-item wrapper div sat between role=listbox and role=option. One angle judged it a gate failure, the other verified axe does NOT flag it (getOwnedRoles recurses through role-less nodes) — so it is an AT-quality defect, not a gate failure. Fixed anyway (separator is now a border, not a node) and locked by TEST-23; found independently by a DOM probe before either report landed.

KB rows lost per-row tabIndex + Enter/Space handlers. ACCEPTED BY DESIGN: the ARIA combobox/listbox model replaces N tab stops with a single focused input plus aria-activedescendant, which is the pattern the design names. It is only sound because the focus-retention fix above landed; without it the keyboard route would be dead.

Five unrelated skip entries + one removal reconcile OTHER features' gate state. ACCEPTED AND DOCUMENTED as ITEM-12: origin/main is already red on this gate in a fresh worktree, so the branch cannot record a green check without it; kept in a separate commit so it can be split off.

UNVERIFIED at report time: the ScrollArea around a listbox of non-focusable options might produce a NEW un-baselined scrollable-region-focusable violation. Resolved empirically by the phase-8 gate:ui run rather than by argument.
